questions.q: What has hands but cannot clap?
questions.e: A clock has hands but cannot clap.

questions.q: What has a head and a tail but no body?
questions.e: Coins have a head side and a tail side.

questions.q: What can you catch but not throw?
questions.e: You can catch a cold.

questions.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
questions.e: A towel dries you and gets wet.

questions.q: What has keys but cannot open a lock?
questions.e: A piano has keys but no locks.

questions.q: What has many teeth but cannot bite?
questions.e: A comb has many teeth.

questions.q: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?
questions.e: An echo repeats your voice.

questions.q: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
questions.e: The more steps you take, the more footsteps you leave.

questions.q: What has to be broken before you can use it?
questions.e: You break an egg before cooking it.

questions.q: What is full of holes but still holds water?
questions.e: A sponge is full of holes yet holds water.

questions.q: If you have me, you want to share me. If you share me, you no longer have me. What am I?
questions.e: Once a secret is shared, it is no longer a secret.

questions.q: What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
questions.e: A stamp sits in the corner of an envelope.

questions.q: What goes up but never comes back down?
questions.e: Your age only goes up.

questions.q: What begins with T, ends with T, and has T inside it?
questions.e: Tea inside a Teapot: T-eapo-T with tea inside.

questions.q: Tom's mother has three children: April, May and...?
questions.e: The answer is in the question: Tom.

questions.q: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left?
questions.e: "All but 9" means 9 stay.

questions.q: How many months have 28 days?
questions.e: Every month has at least 28 days.

questions.q: Which is heavier: 1 kg of feathers or 1 kg of stones?
questions.e: Both weigh exactly one kilogram.

questions.q: A bat and a ball cost N110 together. The bat costs N100 more than the ball. How much is the ball?
questions.e: If the ball is N5, the bat is N105, and together N110.

questions.q: If 3 workers build a wall in 3 days, how many days would 6 workers take at the same pace?
questions.e: The job is 9 worker-days, so 6 workers need 1.5 days.

questions.q: What comes next? 2, 4, 6, 8, ?
questions.e: Add 2 each time.

questions.q: What comes next? 3, 6, 9, 12, ?
questions.e: Add 3 each time.

questions.q: What comes next? 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
questions.e: Double each time.

questions.q: What comes next? A, C, E, G, ?
questions.e: Skip one letter each time.

questions.q: What comes next? 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ?
questions.e: Each number is the sum of the two before it.

questions.q: What comes next? 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.e: These are square numbers: 6 x 6 = 36.

questions.q: Which word does NOT belong: Lagos, Abuja, Kano, Ghana?
questions.e: Ghana is a country; the others are Nigerian cities.

questions.q: Which word does NOT belong: Apple, Mango, Carrot, Banana?
questions.e: Carrot is a vegetable.

questions.q: Rearrange the letters of LISTEN to make another word.
questions.e: LISTEN can become SILENT.

questions.q: Which 5-letter word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?
questions.e: Short + er = Shorter.
